name: Swiss
summary: International Typographic Style: white paper, black grotesk, one signal red, flush-left on a six-column grid, hierarchy from size and position only.
lineage: Josef Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design (1981); Armin Hofmann and the Basel school posters; Neue Grafik (1958-65).

motion.grammar: cut: elements appear in two steps, .32 s, reading order with a 160 ms stagger

frame: a 3px rule across the top with the project left and page right
